	set_variable = { name = zg361_we_final_operation_check value = var:zg361_we_operation_used }
	set_variable = { name = zg361_we_final_gold_check value = var:zg361_we_gold_available }
	change_variable = { name = zg361_we_final_gold_check add = var:zg361_we_gold_reserved }
	change_variable = { name = zg361_we_final_gold_check add = var:zg361_we_gold_paid }
	set_variable = { name = zg361_we_final_hours_check value = var:zg361_we_hours_available }
	change_variable = { name = zg361_we_final_hours_check add = var:zg361_we_hours_output }
	change_variable = { name = zg361_we_final_hours_check add = var:zg361_we_hours_on_call }
	change_variable = { name = zg361_we_final_hours_check add = var:zg361_we_hours_meeting }
	change_variable = { name = zg361_we_final_hours_check add = var:zg361_we_hours_leave }
	change_variable = { name = zg361_we_final_hours_check add = var:zg361_we_hours_governance }
	set_variable = { name = zg361_we_final_shadow_hc_check value = var:zg361_we_shadow_hc_available }
	change_variable = { name = zg361_we_final_shadow_hc_check add = var:zg361_we_shadow_hc_active }
	set_variable = { name = zg361_we_final_formal_hc_check value = var:zg361_ch_hc_available }
	change_variable = { name = zg361_we_final_formal_hc_check add = var:zg361_ch_hc_reserved }
	change_variable = { name = zg361_we_final_formal_hc_check add = var:zg361_ch_hc_occupied }
	change_variable = { name = zg361_we_final_formal_hc_check add = var:zg361_ch_hc_frozen }
	change_variable = { name = zg361_we_final_formal_hc_check add = var:zg361_ch_hc_reclaimed }
	set_variable = { name = zg361_we_final_conservation_ok value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:zg361_we_operation_used >= 0
			var:zg361_we_operation_used <= var:zg361_we_operation_total
			var:zg361_we_gold_available >= 0
			var:zg361_we_gold_reserved >= 0
			var:zg361_we_gold_paid >= 0
			var:zg361_we_hours_available >= 0
			var:zg361_we_hours_output >= 0
			var:zg361_we_hours_on_call >= 0
			var:zg361_we_hours_meeting >= 0
			var:zg361_we_hours_leave >= 0
			var:zg361_we_hours_governance >= 0
			var:zg361_we_shadow_hc_available >= 0
			var:zg361_we_shadow_hc_active >= 0
			var:zg361_ch_hc_available >= 0
			var:zg361_ch_hc_reserved >= 0
			var:zg361_ch_hc_occupied >= 0
			var:zg361_ch_hc_frozen >= 0
			var:zg361_ch_hc_reclaimed >= 0
			var:zg361_we_final_operation_check = 40
			var:zg361_we_final_gold_check = var:zg361_we_gold_total
			var:zg361_we_final_hours_check = var:zg361_we_hours_total
			var:zg361_we_final_shadow_hc_check = var:zg361_we_shadow_hc_total
			var:zg361_we_final_formal_hc_check = var:zg361_ch_hc_authorized
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_final_conservation_ok value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_portfolio_closed value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_portfolio_status value = 6 }
		debug_log = "ZG361WE: workforce/endgame portfolio closed static runtime"
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_last_red_code value = 9099 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_runtime_status value = 4 }
		debug_log = "ZG361WE RED: final conservation failed; portfolio remains open"
	}
}

				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ab_subject

			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_ab_subject_seen_revision value = var:zg361_we_ab_visible_revision }
	}
}

# Internal subject-scope launch; ROOT is the eligible direct manager.
zg361_we_ab_launch_effect = {
	remove_variable = zg361_we_runtime_applied
	zg361_case_ab_open_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zg361_case_kernel_applied var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
		zg361_we_initialize_portfolio_effect = yes
		zg361_we_ab_initialize_effect = yes
		var:zg361_case_ab_owner = { save_scope_as = zg361_we_ab_owner }
		save_scope_as = zg361_we_ab_subject
		save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_we_ab_cycle value = var:zg361_case_ab_cycle_serial }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_we_ab_case value = var:zg361_case_ab_case_serial }
		zg361_we_ab_schedule_stage_01_deadline_effect = yes
		if = {
			limit = { root = { is_ai = yes zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } }
			zg361_we_ab_run_authorized_ai_effect = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { root = { is_ai = no zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } }
			scope:zg361_we_ab_owner = { trigger_event = { id = zg361we.242 } }
		}
	}
}

zg361_we_ab_schedule_stage_01_deadline_effect = {
	zg361_case_kernel_schedule_deadline_effect = {

		SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ab_subject

		CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ab_case_serial

		DEADLINE_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_we_ab_s01_deadline_subject
		DEADLINE_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_we_ab_s01_deadline_cycle

	remove_variable = zg361_we_m262_visible_value

	set_variable = { name = zg361_we_ac_s01_deadline_pending value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = zg361_we_ac_s01_deadline_expired value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = zg361_we_ac_s02_deadline_pending value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = zg361_we_ac_s02_deadline_expired value = 0 }

# Counts/barons are assessed-only: no open, stage, HC or manager authority.
zg361_we_ac_subject_read_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_subject_self_guard_trigger = {
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ac_subject
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ac_active
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_ac_subject_seen_revision value = var:zg361_we_ac_visible_revision }
	}
}

# Internal subject-scope launch; ROOT is the eligible direct manager.
zg361_we_ac_launch_effect = {
	remove_variable = zg361_we_runtime_applied
	zg361_case_ac_open_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zg361_case_kernel_applied var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
		zg361_we_ac_initialize_effect = yes
		var:zg361_case_ac_owner = { save_scope_as = zg361_we_ac_owner }
		save_scope_as = zg361_we_ac_subject
		save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_we_ac_cycle value = var:zg361_case_ac_cycle_serial }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_we_ac_case value = var:zg361_case_ac_case_serial }
		zg361_we_ac_schedule_stage_01_deadline_effect = yes
		if = {
			limit = { root = { is_ai = yes zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } }
			zg361_we_ac_run_authorized_ai_effect = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { root = { is_ai = no zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } }
			scope:zg361_we_ac_owner = { trigger_event = { id = zg361we.254 } }
		}
	}
}

	zg361_case_kernel_schedule_deadline_effect = {

		SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ac_subject

# Counts/barons are assessed-only: no open, stage, HC or manager authority.
zg361_we_ad_subject_read_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_subject_self_guard_trigger = {
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ad_subject
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ad_active
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_ad_subject_seen_revision value = var:zg361_we_ad_visible_revision }
	}
}

zg361_we_ad_run_authorized_ai_effect = {
	# The project owner's second AI exception is silent/background-only.
	if = {
		limit = { root = { is_ai = yes zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } }
		zg361_we_m266_route_a_effect = {
			TICKET_OWNER = scope:zg361_we_ad_owner
			TICKET_SUBJECT = scope:zg361_we_ad_subject
			TICKET_CYCLE = scope:zg361_we_ad_cycle
			TICKET_CASE = scope:zg361_we_ad_case
		}
		zg361_we_m273_route_a_effect = {
			TICKET_OWNER = scope:zg361_we_ad_owner
			TICKET_SUBJECT = scope:zg361_we_ad_subject
			TICKET_CYCLE = scope:zg361_we_ad_cycle
			TICKET_CASE = scope:zg361_we_ad_case
		}
	}
}

# Internal subject-scope launch; ROOT is the eligible direct manager.
zg361_we_ad_launch_effect = {
	remove_variable = zg361_we_runtime_applied
	zg361_case_ad_open_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zg361_case_kernel_applied var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
		zg361_we_ad_initialize_effect = yes
		var:zg361_case_ad_owner = { save_scope_as = zg361_we_ad_owner }
		save_scope_as = zg361_we_ad_subject
		save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_we_ad_cycle value = var:zg361_case_ad_cycle_serial }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_we_ad_case value = var:zg361_case_ad_case_serial }
		zg361_we_ad_schedule_stage_01_deadline_effect = yes
		if = {
			limit = { root = { is_ai = yes zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } }
			zg361_we_ad_run_authorized_ai_effect = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { root = { is_ai = no zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } }
			scope:zg361_we_ad_owner = { trigger_event = { id = zg361we.266 } }
		}
	}
}

# Internal subject-scope launch; ROOT is the eligible direct manager.
zg361_we_al_launch_effect = {
	remove_variable = zg361_we_runtime_applied
	zg361_case_al_open_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zg361_case_kernel_applied var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
		zg361_we_al_initialize_effect = yes
		var:zg361_case_al_owner = { save_scope_as = zg361_we_al_owner }
		save_scope_as = zg361_we_al_subject
		save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_we_al_cycle value = var:zg361_case_al_cycle_serial }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_we_al_case value = var:zg361_case_al_case_serial }
		zg361_we_al_schedule_stage_01_deadline_effect = yes
		if = {
			limit = { root = { is_ai = yes zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } }
			zg361_we_al_run_authorized_ai_effect = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { root = { is_ai = no zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } }
			scope:zg361_we_al_owner = { trigger_event = { id = zg361we.355 } }
		}
	}
}

zg361_we_al_schedule_stage_01_deadline_effect = {
	zg361_case_kernel_schedule_deadline_effect = {
		OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_al_owner
		SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_al_subject
		CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_al_cycle_serial
		CASE_VAR = zg361_case_al_case_serial
		STATE_VAR = zg361_case_al_state
		ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_al_active
		DEADLINE_OWNER_VAR = zg361_we_al_s01_deadline_owner
		DEADLINE_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_we_al_s01_deadline_subject
		DEADLINE_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_we_al_s01_deadline_cycle
		DEADLINE_CASE_VAR = zg361_we_al_s01_deadline_case
		DEADLINE_STATE_VAR = zg361_we_al_s01_deadline_state
		DEADLINE_DAYS_VAR = zg361_we_al_s01_deadline_days
		DEADLINE_PENDING_VAR = zg361_we_al_s01_deadline_pending
		DEADLINE_EXPIRED_VAR = zg361_we_al_s01_deadline_expired
		TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_al_owner
		TICKET_SUBJECT = this
		TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_al_cycle_serial
		TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_al_case_serial
		TICKET_STATE = 1
		DAYS = 180
		EVENT = zg361we.4801
	}
}

zg361_we_al_timeout_stage_01_effect = {
	zg361_we_m355_route_c_effect = {
		TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_al_owner
		TICKET_SUBJECT = this
		TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_al_cycle_serial
		TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_al_case_serial
		TICKET_STATE = 1
	}
	zg361_we_m356_route_c_effect = {
		TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_al_owner
		TICKET_SUBJECT = this
		TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_al_cycle_serial
		TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_al_case_serial
		TICKET_STATE = 1
	}
	debug_log = "ZG361WE: AL stage 1 exact deadline consumed"
}

		TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_al_cycle_serial
		TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_al_case_serial
		TICKET_STATE = 4
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:zg361_case_al_owner = { is_ai = no }
			var:zg361_case_al_state = 5
		}
		var:zg361_case_al_owner = { trigger_event = { id = zg361we.361 } }
	}
